events.title: Abbey Road: 57 Years of Iconic Music
events.blurb: The Beatles' legendary album 'Abbey Road' was originally released on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and that famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: This day marks 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: That iconic album cover, those legendary tracks... 'Abbey Road' by The Beatles is 57 years old today! Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the extraordinary Freddie Mercury, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Morning tribute
angles.copy: Eighty years ago today, the world gained a legend. Remembering Freddie Mercury and his incredible legacy.

angles.name: Afternoon tribute
angles.copy: The showman, the voice, the legend. Freddie Mercury would have been 80 today. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: From 'Brass in Pocket' to her latest work, Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today. A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger.

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment or lyric? The Oasis frontman turns 54 today. As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was originally released in September 1971 in the US and October 1971 in the UK, making it 55 years since its debut.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates today.

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: The album that gave us a global anthem for peace. John Lennon's 'Imagine' is 55 years old.

events.title: The Original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music and celebrating its 25th anniversary this month.

angles.name: Morning tech nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod changed how we listened to music forever. What was your first model?

angles.name: Afternoon tech talk
angles.copy: Before streaming, there was the iPod. Celebrating 25 years since Apple put '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Which Bond actor is your favourite?

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: Celebrating all things 007 for James Bond Day. What's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Morning tribute
angles.copy: Eighty-six years ago today, a musical icon was born. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring message.

angles.name: Afternoon tribute
angles.copy: From Liverpool to the world, John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese!

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese turns 87 today. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album: 58 Years of Musical Diversity
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing a diverse range of styles.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece.

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: From 'Blackbird' to 'Helter Skelter', 'The White Album' is 58 years old today. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Morning tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an irreplaceable voice. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Afternoon tribute
angles.copy: His legacy lives on. Today marks 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing. What's your favourite Queen performance?

events.title: Rubber Soul: 61 Years of Folk-Rock Evolution
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: Morning mention
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that changed everything.

angles.name: Afternoon highlight
angles.copy: From 'Drive My Car' to 'In My Life', 'Rubber Soul' turns 61 today. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away 46 years ago on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Morning tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless message of peace.

angles.name: Afternoon tribute
angles.copy: His music and spirit continue to inspire. Today marks 46 years since the passing of John Lennon.
